note: Frozen training protocol of the paper. The split search uses its own seed (20260812) and is independent of the three training seeds; only initialization and batch order vary between 42, 43 and 44.

loss.single_label: CrossEntropyLoss with inverse-frequency class weights normalized to sum to the class count
loss.multi_label: BCEWithLogitsLoss with pos_weight = (n - positives) / positives, computed on train only
loss.multitask: weighted CE (stage) + pos-weighted BCE (tissue), equal task weights

timm.m2_oversampling: training split only; minority M2 classes (NECROSE SECA and AMBAS) replicated up to the majority count, seeded by the training seed

yolo_classify.checkpoint_selection: Ultralytics best.pt by top-1 validation accuracy
yolo_classify.m2_oversampling: training split only, materialized as hard links by build_yolo_datasets.py

detector.note: Single run on its own 1059/227/228 partition. Not repeated across the three seeds and never combined with a classification metric.

calibration.nc_fusion_selection: validation macro F1 per family and seed; AND preserved on ties

evaluation.primary_metric: macro F1 over a fixed label set, zero division mapped to zero
evaluation.joint_metric: joint_exact requires the stage label and the complete tissue vector to be correct

bootstrap.method: hierarchical percentile bootstrap resampling training seeds and paired test identifiers
bootstrap.interpretation: an interval containing zero is inconclusive, not evidence of equality
